chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him) on some of the days of Siffin, when he saw his son al-Hasan (peace be upon him) hastening to the war.

key_terms.الْحَسَنَ: Al-Hasan ibn Ali, the eldest son of Imam Ali.
key_terms.صِفِّينَ: Siffin, the location of the famous battle between Imam Ali and Muawiyah.

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali observe about Imam Hasan during the Battle of Siffin?
ai.summary: This narration captures a poignant moment during the Battle of Siffin (657 CE) where Imam Ali (or 37 AH), where Imam Ali (peace be upon him) observed his son, Imam al-Hasan (peace be upon him), eagerly rushing into battle. It highlights the familial bond and the characteristic zeal of the Ahl al-Bayt in the context of military engagement, reflecting the transition of leadership and the embodiment of prophetic virtues in the next generation. The scene underscores the spiritual and physical readiness of the Imams, serving as a model for Shia believers in balancing courage with divine awareness.
